text: {"408":{"about":["rustc_parse","rustc_session"],"refers":[],"why":"The parser lexer and parser are tied to the parsing session, whose state outlives individual parsers."},"409":{"about":["rustc_session"],"refers":["rustc_span"],"why":"This describes ParseSess as holding parsing state and a SourceMap, which is defined by rustc_span."},"410":{"about":["rustc_parse"],"refers":[],"why":"It describes the parser encountering macro definitions and invocations while reading source."},"411":{"about":["rustc_parse","rustc_expand"],"refers":[],"why":"Parsing preserves macro constructs for the macro-expansion machinery to expand later."},"412":{"about":["rustc_expand","rustc_parse"],"refers":[],"why":"Macro expansion recursively invokes parsing on expansion output, which can expose further macros."}}
